description_en: Queries the data masking rules of a PolarDB cluster or the information about a specified masking rule
description_zh: 查询PolarDB集群下所有的脱敏规则或目标脱敏规则的详情
name: DescribeMaskingRules

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of the clusters that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account, such as cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the masking rule
parameters.name: rule_name_list

parameters.help_en:
Queries data masking rules or encryption rules. Valid values:

v1: queries data masking rules. v2: queries data encryption rules
parameters.help_zh:
获取脱敏加密规则。取值范围如下：

v1：获取脱敏规则。
v2：获取加密规则
parameters.name: interface_version

Data.description_en: The result data that is returned

items.description_en:
The detailed configurations of the masking rule.

For more information, see the `RuleConfig` parameter in the [ModifyMaskingRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212574.html） operation
items.description_zh:
脱敏规则详细配置。
关于各参数的详细介绍，详情请参见[ModifyMaskingRules]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212574.html）中0的参数描述
items.example: "{\"testrule\":{\"auto\":{\"databases\":[],\"tables\":[\"t1\"],\"columns\":[\"c1\"]},\"applies_to\":[],\"description\":\"This rule will be applied to the columns c1 in table t1\",\"enabled\":\"true\"}}"

RuleVersion.description_en: The version of the masking rule. Valid values: v1 and v2. Default value: v1
RuleVersion.description_zh: 脱敏规则版本, 取值v1、v2, 默认值 v1

Message.description_en:
The message that is returned for the request.

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid value:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
请求结果。取值：

true：请求成功。

false：请求失败
